description: Frictionless Table Schema of Platform/01-store/forms/refusals.tsv (ADR-0125 addenda (12), (13); OBSH.39.3). Every field is a raw string: no type coercion. Constraints only where the header of the form or the existing check states them; CEL, JSON, owner, typed, numeric and prose-agreement rules stay with the existing checks (raw map of the change 0125-forms-table-schema-p01).

fields.name: row
fields.description: The row of the N4 table of the chapter, from 1.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The condition, snake_case, unique in the file.

fields.name: code
fields.description: An HTTP code; exit 2; exit !0; - (no answer).

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The wire word kind (OpenAPI *Fault); - at start and cli; the agreement with OpenAPI stays with check_refusals.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Fields besides kind and error, comma-separated, ? optional; -.
